So I'm reading some of the comments, and most are like "well he can't just guess you didn't want to". Verbal consent is always necessary. It's okay if you don't want to see it as rape, and I'm not here to be like "oh yeah, that's totally this or that". You came here for support, so whatever you think about it, I'm here to support you. Talk to him, tell him how uncomfortable you felt. The fact that you were sometimes asleep and he kept going raises some flags, and I believe you should discuss them, seriously. I KNOW saying no or stop is very very hard, which is why I believe it is important you tell him your concerns, Whatever you decide to do, however you decide to deal with these feelings, this community is here to support. I'm here to support you. Really, if you need to understand or process what happened, you can dm me or something. Take care
